sayLines: A person, maybe 60s, with freckles heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin."
A woman, maybe 50s heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going."
A person, maybe 20s heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
A person, maybe 60s, with a missing fingertip heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
A woman, maybe 40s, with grey-streaked hair heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
A man, maybe 50s heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
A woman, maybe 60s heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
A man, maybe 60s heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
A woman, maybe 40s, with a shaved head heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
A man, maybe 40s is mending something by the door — patient work.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
MOLT: your skin splits. You step out new, whole — and naked. All equipped gear lost in the old skin. (Once per week.)
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND **Molt**. It resonates with: something unnamed.
